item.title: KVM Windows 11 Virtual Machine Fine Tuning
item.description: It is really unfortunate that I have to do this at a university that should be operating system and Office suite agnostic (especially for a degree in Information Technology); but I needed to setup a Windows 11 virtual machine just so that I could use the Microsoft 365 Office Suite for some classes now that Microsoft is no longer supporting Windows 10. Some of you, as you read this, are probably saying “Just use LibreOffice”. And I do; I use it frequently when I can. But, if you have used LibreOffice enough you know that sometimes the translations to Microsoft Office format does not always populate correctly.
